BETA Close X Serco Group PLC has announced the purchase of 1,004,147 ordinary shares on July 1, 2026, for an average price of 222.57 pence per share, 1,020,000 ordinary shares on July 2, 2026, for an average price of 228.74 pence per share, and 326,904 ordinary shares on July 3, 2026, for an average price of 229.91 pence per share, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. Following these transactions, the company's total issued ordinary shares, excluding treasury shares, stand at 980,751,819, with 21,994,195 ordinary shares held in treasury. The total number of voting rights is now 980,751,819. Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 03 July 2026 03 July 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 5 March 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (" Ordinary Shares ") through RBC Europe Limited. The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 21,994,195 . The total number of voting rights in the Company, excluding treasury shares as at 03 July 2026 is 980,751,819 . This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 5 March 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 21,994,195 Ordinary Shares, which are held in treasury.
